sheets.subject: Arranged in one full-bleed square: (1) ONE seamless top-down mixed deciduous forest-floor tile, brown leaf litter, fine soil and sparse tiny twigs; neutral diffuse light, no horizon, roots, large stones, paths or directional shadows; repeat on both axes; intended footprint 4 x 4 m, surface datum height 0 m.

Arranged in one uninterrupted horizontal panorama: (1) distant mixed oak-lime woodland edge, hazel lower storey, occasional birch; non-tiling far landscape strip, canopy silhouette and opaque vegetation down to baseline; no mountains, buildings or giant conifer plantation; intended width 100 m, vegetation height 20 m, front-facing at eye height 1.6 m.

Arranged in two wide strips stacked one above the other with wide white paper between them: (1) top strip, 14 m high: a woodland screen of oak and lime, several trunks side by side with their leaf masses drawn as outlined cloud-like clumps and light single-direction hatching, small gaps of white paper between some trunks and leaves; (2) bottom strip, 4 m high: a low hazel woodland edge, many thin stems with outlined leaf clumps. Line drawing on white paper: outlines and sparse hatching only, never solid black areas. Each strip's left and right edges have the same height so it can repeat sideways.

Arranged in three separate generous cells: (1) mature oak, 18 m high; (2) mature lime, 20 m high; (3) birch cluster sharing one coherent silhouette, 12 m high; complete roots-to-crown cut-outs, woodland growth forms, no ground patch, no cast shadow, frontal eye-height view; trunks readable against deeper screens.

Arranged in four separate cells: (1) low fern clump 0.65 m; (2) young hazel stool 1.8 m; (3) bramble tangle 0.8 m; (4) low woodland herb clump 0.25 m; separate transparent cut-outs with no soil islands or cast shadows, soft green woodland palette, no autumn fruit forced into summer vegetation.
